scope: Proposition 8.10 (Sharp interaction and middle-phase tail) of the manuscript “A positive resolution of De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight” (preprints/De-Giorgis-conjecture-in-dimension-eight-September-26-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 375 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6c92e90f31e12f32), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 64. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Lemma 8.9, for each ε > 0 there is Pε < ∞ such that every fixed P ≥ Pε has the following properties when N is sufficiently large. If a different sheet is within C0 log N of the base, then IP (z) ≥ (32 − ε)e− √ 2ℓmin(z) . (8.18) If x lies between two adjacent sheets, their distances si, sj from x are both at most C0 log N, they are the nearest sheets, and |si − sj| ≤ C1 for a fixed C1, then q(x) ≤ (4 + ε) ( e− √ 2si + e− √ 2sj ) . (8.19) Largeness of N may depend on all the fixed parameters, including P, C1, ε. The window geometry and conclusions are uniform in the solution and center.
